jobs.description:
Do you enjoy being on the road and making friendly conversations at the door? Get started as a delivery driver for a major national player in e-commerce and logistics! In your own delivery van, you will drive independently through the region to deliver orders neatly to consumers and businesses. Your favorite music playing in the cabin, out on the open road, and staying physically active—it's the ideal combination! 🎶📦

What we offer
- A salary up to € 18,83 per hour !
- Opportunity for a permanent contract 🎉
- A pleasant, informal work atmosphere 😊
- You receive a travel allowance and a pension plan
- Schedule your own shifts via the app!
- Flexible shifts !

Who you are
You are an enthusiastic and social driver who prioritizes safety and customer friendliness. At the front door, you serve as a professional ambassador, and you have no problem staying physically active, such as walking up stairs with deliveries. Physical work is easy for you! You can effortlessly lift crates weighing up to 22 kg. 💪 Furthermore, you recognize yourself in the following points:

- You have a car available and have held your driver's license for at least 6 months. 🚗
- You are available at least 2 days a week (including at least one weekend day or evening shift). 🗓️
- You speak and understand English or Dutch well. 🗣️

What will you do
As a delivery driver, your shift starts at the hub or depot. After a cup of coffee and a brief catch-up with your colleagues, you inspect your vehicle and the loaded orders. Then you hop in and hit the road!

Using a handy navigation system, you drive safely from address to address. Once you arrive at the customer's location, you carry the crates or boxes neatly up to the front door. You engage in a brief chat, collect any return items, and handle the delivery efficiently. After completing your route, you drive back to the depot, park the van neatly, and wrap up a satisfying workday together with your colleagues! ✅

 About Stromma Group 
Stromma Group is the leading provider of experiences within sightseeing in Northern Europe. These experiences focus on sightseeing tours, entertainment and activities for tourists, local residents and companies. Stromma has a history dating back to 1809 with a strong tradition of historic and cultural values. Today Stromma operates in 18 destinations in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, Germany, and the Netherlands. Sustainability at Stromma 
Stromma focuses with its new strategy on sustainable tourism. Our vision is therefore: Northern Europe's leading sustainable producer and provider of tours and activities. Stromma Netherlands has been rewarded with the Green Key certificate. The burden on the environment is further limited by the increasing use of electricity to replace the current natural gas and hybrid diesel-electric engines.
